description: This file defines the Timer class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, including enums, structs, and method declarations for a timer plugin that supports JSONRPC communication, timer management, and event notifications.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A plugin class implementing timer functionalities with JSONRPC interface, including methods for starting, canceling, suspending, resuming timers, and sending notifications.

methods.description: Wrapper method to suspend a timer.

methods.description: Wrapper method to resume a suspended timer.

methods.description: Wrapper method to get the status of a specific timer.

methods.name: getTimersWrapper
